turbo_Entity.severityBreakdown.NORMAL.justification: Normal severity breakdown can be related to the number of CVEs, as normal issues could have CVEs, though typically fewer than critical or major ones.

turbo_Entity.severityBreakdown.MAJOR.justification: Major severity breakdown can be related to the risk score, as major issues also contribute to the risk score, though less than critical ones.
Major severity breakdown can be related to the number of CVEs, as major issues may also have CVEs associated with them.
Major severity breakdown can be related to the number of CVEs in top vulnerable applications, as major issues may also have CVEs associated with them.
Major severity breakdown can be related to impacted public APIs, as major issues may also impact public APIs.

turbo_Entity.severityBreakdown.CRITICAL.justification: Critical severity breakdown can be related to the risk score, as critical issues contribute significantly to the risk score.
Critical severity breakdown can be related to the risk score of top vulnerable applications, as critical issues contribute significantly to the risk score.
Critical severity breakdown can be related to the number of CVEs, as critical issues often have CVEs associated with them.
Critical severity breakdown can be related to impacted public APIs, as critical issues often impact public APIs.
Critical severity breakdown can be related to the number of CVEs in top vulnerable applications, as critical issues often have CVEs associated with them.
Critical severity breakdown can be related to impacted public APIs in top vulnerable applications, as critical issues often impact public APIs.

turbo_Entity.severityBreakdown.MINOR.justification: Minor severity breakdown can be related to the number of CVEs, as minor issues might have fewer but still relevant CVEs.
